{{Quote|Hey! That's my dinner!|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], upon discovering a [[Yoda's species/Legends|creature]] (Yoda) trying to eat a ration bar|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
[[File:Numa_Eating_Ration_Bar.png|thumb|250px|[[Numa/Legends|Numa]] eating a ration bar.]]

'''Ration bars''', also known as '''supply bars''', were a type of [[food rations]] carried by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and used in [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] [[Survival kit/Legends|survival kits]]. Clone troopers [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] gave a ration bar to the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]] [[Numa/Legends|Numa]]. Although [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] allegedly found the ration bars to be unpleasant, the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] apparently found the taste pleasing when he was given one by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].
